propositions: Read-only deterministic derivations over git history and working tree must expose module-size distribution, cap-change events, short-term churn, and refactor-to-addition ratio metrics against a single flat hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt
module_size_distribution() scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts at a git ref against the single-sourced cap and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc
cap_change_events() surfaces commits changing .github/module-size-limit.txt as list[dict] with old_limit and new_limit; empty list [] when no changes in range
churn() sums insertions and deletions from git log --numstat over a range; refactor_to_addition_ratio() returns deletions/insertions or None when total insertions is zero
Four metrics must be registered in c085 registry with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high, wrapped in context-adapter compute callables that pull repo_root and range from context
